newsitem.title: INDIA: Jet Airways to take delivery of 2 GECAS.
newsitem.headline: Jet Airways to take delivery of 2 GECAS.

text.p: India's Jet Airways is due to take delivery of two dry-lease GECAS Boeing 737-400s this month and has placed an order with Boeing for six B737-800s and four B737-400s, a Jet spokesman said.
The dry leases have the usual option to purchase while the 10-plane order financing is under discussion with the Washington-based Exim Bank, he added.
The two dry-lease aircraft will start operating in July, twice a day Delhi-Chennai(Madras)-Delhi and once a day Delhi-Jaipur-Delhi, Delhi-Lucknow-Delhi and Chennai-Bangalore-Pune.
The spokesman said they were keen to increase cargo operations because the cargo sector was buoyant, but they needed to look at the potential for their own bonded warehousing to maximise operations.
Jet's existing 12 aircraft are one 737-500, six 737-400s and five 737-300s.
